metaTitle: WhatsApp SDK, REST APIs and managed hosting
metaDescription: Use WPPConnect to automate WhatsApp with Node.js, call a self-hosted REST API or connect your application to WPPConnect Cloud. Compare the projects and read the API guides.
heroDescription: WPPConnect provides open-source tools to send messages and receive WhatsApp events. Use WA-JS inside WhatsApp Web, use the SDK in Node.js, or call a REST API from your application.
codeNote: Receive a message and reply from Node.js.
ecosystemTitle: Which WPPConnect project should I use?
ecosystemDescription: Choose by where your code runs: in the browser, in a Node.js process or in a service that calls an HTTP API.
libraryDescription: Create sessions, send messages and build bots directly from your Node.js application.
serverDescription: A ready-to-run REST API for messages, sessions, contacts, groups and webhooks.
wajsDescription: Work with WhatsApp Web functions through a focused JavaScript API.
delphiDescription: Bring WPPConnect integrations to your Delphi desktop applications.
cloudTitle: Connect to WhatsApp through a managed API
cloudDescription: WPPConnect Cloud runs the Go server for you. Pair your number by QR code, create an API key and receive session and messaging events at your webhook endpoint.
cloudSessions: Manage your sessions from a single dashboard.
cloudKeys: Create API keys with clear permissions.
cloudWebhooks: Connect your application through API calls and webhooks.
communityTitle: A project you can be part of.
communityDescription: Read the docs, share what you learn and support the people building the ecosystem.
learnDescription: Follow the tutorial and explore the API documentation for your integration.
contributeDescription: Report issues, improve the documentation or contribute your next pull request.
sponsorDescription: Help maintainers keep the projects moving through Open Collective.
questionsDescription: Meet developers and maintainers in the official WPPConnect community.
designDescription: The shared WPPConnect design system for the website and Cloud. Colors, typography and controls use the same versioned tokens.
designPreview: Interactive preview only. No account data is changed.
guideLink: Compare the SDK, WA-JS and HTTP servers
goDescription: Run a WhatsApp HTTP API in Go on your own infrastructure, or use its managed deployment on WPPConnect Cloud.
